overview:
Thalang is the district that covers most of northern Phuket, including Cherng Talay, Si Sunthon, Nai Yang and Mai Khao. This page lists projects whose records give Thalang (or the Thep Krasattri subdistrict) as the location without a more specific beach area.
Most are villa developments set inland, plus a townhouse project; the nearby-places data lists distances to Bang Tao and Layan beaches, schools and hospitals in Thalang for the named projects.
